[UNIVERSAL]
[^] ServerHop and AutoRejoin have a Mode: Least Players, Most Players, Lowest Ping, Highest FPS or Random; it replaces Sort
[^] ServerHop has Skip visited servers, on by default, so it never picks a server you already left
[!] ServerHop and AutoRejoin no longer start two server searches at once
[BEDWARS]
[!] SilentAim no longer makes the game a little slower with every reinject
[GENERAL]
[+] AetherV2 Premium: put your key in the loader line with Key = '...' to load v4, locked to one Roblox account and one device; keys are sold on aetherv2.xyz
[^] A few large modules are fetched on every launch instead of being saved on your computer
[GUI]
[^] Module lists and settings are built the first time you open them, which shortens loading
